title: Knight-Errant
summary: KNIGHT-ER'RANT, noun [knight and Latin errans, erro, to wander.] A wandering knight; a knight who traveled in search of adventures, for the purpose of exhibiting military skill, prowess and generosity

inlines.v: KNIGHT-ER'RANT, noun [knight and Latin errans, erro, to wander.] A wandering knight; a knight who traveled in search of adventures, for the purpose of exhibiting military skill, prowess and generosity.
